nextiva_new_or_updated_workitem_trigger.description: Runs for each workitem added or changed in Nextiva. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

nextiva_new_workitem_trigger.description: Runs for each new workitem in Nextiva. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
